name: Sheraton Grand Tbilisi Metechi Palace
insider_take: Perched dramatically on the historic Metechi cliff overlooking the Mtkvari River, this palace-like retreat puts you at the crossroads of Europe and Asia in Georgia's captivating capital.
whats_special: The hotel occupies one of Tbilisi's most iconic locations - the ancient Metechi Rock where King Vakhtang Gorgasali founded the city in the 5th century. Your room windows frame sweeping views of the Old Town's colorful balconies, sulfur baths, and the imposing Narikala Fortress. The building itself mirrors traditional Georgian architecture while housing modern luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on higher floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the ancient Metekhi Church and Vakhtang Gorgasali's equestrian statue just steps from your hotel.
dont_miss: Walk 3 minutes to the famous sulfur baths district where legend says King Gorgasali discovered the hot springs that gave Tbilisi its name ("warm place"). The cable car to Narikala Fortress departs nearby, offering panoramic city views. Stroll across the ultra-modern Peace Bridge at sunset - it's illuminated with 30,000 LED bulbs creating a stunning light show every hour after dark.
pros: Prime historic location overlooking Mtkvari River and Old Town
Luxurious accommodations with panoramic city views
Multiple dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
cons: Historic building may have structural limitations
